name: components-community-notification-list
title: Notification List
description: A small dark panel holds three notification rows stacked on top of each other; hovering spreads them into a readable list and swaps the footer label to View all.
use: A compact corner widget should show a few recent alerts and expand in place on hover.
avoid: Hover-only opening hides the full list from touch and keyboard users, and three rows is a small ceiling.
a11y: The panel is not focusable, so expansion is hover-only and unreachable by keyboard or touch; View all is a plain span. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded charcoal panel on a black stage contains three rounded rows, each with a title, a right-aligned repeat count, and a grey line of time and subtitle. Collapsed, the rows overlap into one stack; a grey circle with 3 sits beside the footer label.
behaves: On hover the rows spring apart to full width while the footer text fades from Notifications to View all; leaving collapses them back into a tight stack.
customise: The three alerts are written inside the component, so titles, times and counts need a file edit; the width, spring and hover trigger are fixed in source too.
weight: light: Three small cards and one spring; nothing runs until hover.
